character: A large resort in the Appi Highlands of Iwate, about 50 km north of Morioka, with long groomed runs on two peaks, Maemoriyama and Nishimoriyama. Resort hotels are clustered at the base.
learning: Reference, confirm: long, wide groomed runs and resort ski schools make it a common family choice; the ability split was not captured.
